title: Office Support & Coordinator
description:
Office & Business Support Coordinator
Location: London
Reporting To: HR Manager
Department: Operations / Administration

Role Purpose
The Office & Business Support Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the London office, while providing general administrative and business support across the organisation. The role also provides light administrative support to the HR function, particularly in relation to onboarding, induction arrangements and routine employee administration.

The successful candidate will oversee office administration, facilities coordination, supplier management, employee onboarding logistics, and general business support activities, whilst also assisting with some HR administration and employee lifecycle processes.

Key Responsibilities
Office Management & Facilities

Act as the primary point of contact for all office-related matters.
Ensure the office is maintained to a professional standard at all times.
Manage relationships with building management, contractors and external suppliers.
Coordinate office maintenance, repairs and facilities requests.
Order and manage office supplies, stationery and refreshments.
Monitor office budgets and expenditure.
Manage meeting room bookings and office logistics.
Coordinate courier services, post and deliveries.
Assist with office health and safety administration.
Support company events, meetings and staff functions.

Front of House & Business Support

Welcome visitors and clients to the office.
Manage incoming calls and general enquiries.
Coordinate travel, accommodation and meeting arrangements where required.
Assist senior management with administrative tasks.
Support document management, filing and record keeping.
Coordinate company-wide communications and announcements.

HR Administration

Support onboarding and induction arrangements for new starters.
Coordinate right-to-work checks and other pre-employment requirements (reference & DBS).
Respond to routine employee enquiries and direct more complex queries appropriately

Employee Experience

Help create a positive and professional workplace environment.
Support employee wellbeing and engagement initiatives.
Assist in organising team events and company celebrations.
Act as a helpful and approachable contact for employees.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

Previous office administration, office management or coordination experience.
Excellent organisational and planning skills.
Strong attention to detail.
Professional communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong Microsoft Office skills.
Confidence in using AI tools appropriately and responsibly to improve efficiency, support administrative tasks and streamline routine processes.
Proactive and self-motivated approach.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Desirable

Experience within professional services, insurance or financial services.

Key Success Measures

Office operates smoothly and professionally on a day-to-day basis.
Facilities and supplier issues are resolved promptly.
New starters experience a seamless onboarding process.
Records remain accurate and compliant.
Positive feedback from employees and visitors regarding office support.
Effective management of office costs and resources.

5 days in the office with some flexibility

Employee Benefits:
Pension scheme (Aegon 4 or 5% with company matching the same)
Private medical insurance
Medicash
Life assurance
Income Protection
25 days Annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays
Supportive and professional working environment
Learning and development support
Company social events and employee engagement initiatives
Office-based role in London with exposure to a collaborative business environment

title: Payroll and HR Operations Administrator
description:
Payroll & HR Operations CoordinatorWembley, West London
£40,000 - £45,000
6-Month Fixed-Term Contract
5 Days a Week in the Office
Immediate Start Only!

We are partnering with a fast-growing, values-driven food business that has built its reputation on quality, care and doing things the right way. With a collaborative culture, strong values and an emphasis on teamwork, this is a fantastic opportunity to join a business where people genuinely enjoy working together and supporting one another.

As Payroll & HR Operations Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the HR and Payroll function during an exciting period of change.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being at the heart of a team, taking ownership of important administrative and operational tasks, and providing support wherever it's needed. You'll work closely with colleagues across HR, Payroll and Finance, ensuring employee data is accurate, organised and payroll-ready.

Key Responsibilities
- Collate, validate and prepare payroll data for submission to an outsourced payroll provider.
- Support the monthly payroll process through data checking, reconciliation and investigation of discrepancies.
- Manage and maintain large volumes of employee data across HR and payroll systems.
- Produce and analyse reports using Excel to support business and payroll requirements.
- Support a major HR systems implementation project, including data cleansing, testing, validation and migration activities.
- Ensure high levels of data accuracy and integrity at all times.
- Provide day-to-day operational support to the wider HR team, helping to coordinate activities and keep priorities on track.
- Assist with ad-hoc projects, administration and process improvement initiatives.
- Build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across the business.

About You

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and genuinely enjoys supporting a team.

You'll have:
- Strong experience working with large datasets.
- Excellent Excel skills, including functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS and IF statements.
- Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- The ability to spot inconsistencies and investigate data issues.
- A collaborative, team-first approach and willingness to support wherever needed.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Previous experience in payroll, HR administration, HR systems, data administration, finance administration or a similar role.

Why Apply?
- Join a successful and growing business with a strong people-focused culture.
- Work within a supportive, collaborative and friendly team environment.
- Gain exposure to a significant HR systems implementation project.
- Opportunity to make a real impact in a business that values quality, integrity and continuous improvement.

Experience:
- Payroll, HR, Finance or Data Administration: 2+ years preferred
- Advanced Excel: Preferred
- Data analysis and reconciliation: Preferred

We are happy to provide application and/or accessibility support, please contact your Marks Sattin or Grafton consultant directly to discuss your needs. We're committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients, please visit and for our privacy policy.

title: Payroll and Operations Assistant
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an organised and proactive People & Payroll Administrator to work for our client. Providing administrative and operational support across our Payroll, Talent and People Operations function.

This is a varied role combining People/HR administration with hands-on payroll processing, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working across different areas of the employee lifecycle.

Working closely with the Performance & Learning Partner, with a dotted reporting line to the Compensation & Benefits Manager for payroll activities, you will play an important role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the People function.

A key part of the position will be supporting the Group Payroll Partner with weekly payroll processing and providing full payroll cover during periods of absence. You will therefore need previous payroll processing experience and the confidence to take ownership when required.

Key ResponsibilitiesPeople & Team Administration
- Provide accurate and efficient day-to-day administrative support across the Talent and People Operations team.
- Manage shared People team inboxes, ensuring queries are reviewed, prioritised and either resolved or directed to the appropriate person.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and People data.
- Prepare employee and company communications, ensuring information is clear, professional and accurate.
- Support the organisation of meetings, training sessions, team events and other People initiatives.
- Assist with departmental projects and wider People activities.
- Provide additional administrative support as team priorities and business requirements evolve.

Payroll
- Support the Group Payroll Partner with the accurate and timely processing of the weekly payroll.
- Process payroll information including starters, leavers, employee changes and other payroll amendments.
- Provide full payroll processing cover when the Group Payroll Partner is absent, ensuring payroll continues to run accurately and to agreed deadlines.
- Respond to payroll queries and work with employees and internal stakeholders to resolve issues.
- Maintain accurate payroll records and identify any discrepancies, missing information or potential issues at an early stage.
- Ensure payroll information is handled confidentially and in accordance with internal processes and data protection requirements.

Systems, Data & Reporting
- Support the production of monthly People reports and management information.
- Maintain accurate employee information across HR and payroll systems.
- Assist with system administration, campaigns and updates across platforms including Atlas Recruit, Ascend Learning, Applaud Recognition and Payroll systems.
- Produce straightforward reports and collate data as required by the wider People team.
- Carry out regular checks to maintain high levels of data accuracy and integrity.

Experience & Skills

We are looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience within a People/HR, Payroll or People Operations administration role.
- Practical experience of supporting or processing payroll.
- Experience processing starters, leavers and employee/payroll changes.
- The confidence and knowledge to provide payroll processing cover when required.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when working with employee and payroll data.
- Good Excel and general Microsoft Office skills.
- Experience working with HRIS, payroll or other employee management systems.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- A professional and discreet approach when handling confidential employee and payroll information.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to support different areas of the People function.

Desirable Experience

It would be advantageous, although not essential, to have:
- Experience of weekly payroll processing.
- Previous experience within a multi-site or group business.
- Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding, learning & development or employee engagement activities.
- Experience producing People/HR reports and working with employee data.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a broad People Operations position where they can develop their experience across HR administration, payroll, systems, data, Talent and Learning & Development.

The successful individual will become an important part of the People team, taking ownership of essential day-to-day processes while supporting the wider team in delivering an excellent service to employees across the business.

title: Senior Administrator
description:
We are looking for a motivated and experienced Senior Administrator to join our team in London. This role is full time role, working 37.5 hours a week.

Do you want to make a difference every day? Do you want to contribute to change & improvement for those who need it?

Do you have resilience & adaptability? Can you work effectively with a focus on customer service and care?

If yes, then we'd love to hear from you

What we offer

At Victim Support, we are committed to attracting and retaining the best talent. Our competitive rewards and benefits package includes:
- Flexible Working Options: Including hybrid working.
- Generous Annual Leave: 28 days plus Bank Holidays, increasing to 33 days plus Bank Holidays, with options to buy or sell annual leave.
- Birthday Leave: An extra day off for your birthday.
- Pension Plan: 5% employer contribution.
- Enhanced Allowances: Enhanced sick pay, maternity, and paternity payments.
- Exclusive Discounts: High Street, retail, holiday, gym, entertainment, and leisure discounts.
- Financial Wellbeing: Access to our financial wellbeing hub and salary-deducted finance.
- Wellbeing Support: Employee assistance programme and wellbeing support.
- Inclusive Networks: Access to EDI networks and colleague cafes.
- Sustainable Travel: Cycle to work scheme and season ticket loans.
- Career Development: Ongoing training and support with opportunities for career progression.

About the role

As a Senior Administrator you will ensure a high quality and responsive administrative function meets service delivery requirements.

You will provide support on day to day operations, offering support and guidance on more complex administration tasks, monitoring workload and ensuring quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate and participate in all administrative functions to ensure the smooth and effective running of the service, monitoring quality standards for the team through auditing and reporting where required.
- Provide effective line management of staff to ensure performance targets and agreed outcomes are met by the service. Monitor and oversee administration provision, identifying learning and development opportunities to improve service delivery.
- Act as first point of contact for key stakeholders, ensuring administration is dealt with efficiently and meets quality standards and lead by example on good working practices.
- Recruitment and support of Service Delivery Apprentices including liaison with educational providers to support their progression through the apprenticeship scheme.
- Responsible for the induction for new starters, ensuring mandatory training is completed, including training on bespoke case management system and support with access to e-learning modules.
- Ensure compliance with Health and Safety & fire records in accordance with VS Policies and procedures including premises risk assessments, monitoring and any identified remedial action.
- Data quality management for the wider team through analysis of audit's and monitoring compliance ensuring all confidential and sensitive data is stored securely in accordance with VS Data Protection Policy and compliance with GDPR.
- Comply and keep up to date with VS Data Protection Policy, GDPR data protection legislation, confidentiality and organisational policies and procedures, as well as all legislation connected to your work.
- Management of VS Assets including mobile phones, computers, photocopiers etc.
- Work as part of a team to ensure that all outcomes and KPI measures are met.
- Ensuring all confidential and sensitive data is stored securely in accordance with VS Data Protection Policy and compliance with GDPR.

About You

Ideally, you will have experience working within a client focused service and a good understanding and knowledge of office systems.

You will need:
- Effective verbal and written communication and numerical skills.
- Experience working in an administrative setting
- Experience of providing administrative support to a team
- Understanding and knowledge of the requirements relating to confidentiality and data protection.
- Understanding and knowledge of equal opportunities and diversity.
- Ability to prioritise own workload and deal with competing demands in an organised and methodical manner.
- Good IT skills and experience of using all packages in the standard Microsoft Office suite and case management systems/databases.
- Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate sensitively and effectively both verbally and in writing with a wide range of individuals and audiences.
- Ability to work on own initiative and with minimal supervision to achieve deadlines.
- Strong record keeping skills with a focus on quality and accuracy.

About Us

Victim Support is an independent charity dedicated to supporting people affected by crime and traumatic incidents in England and Wales. We put them at the heart of our organisation and our support and campaigns are informed and shaped by them and their experiences.

Victim Support are committed to recruiting with care and to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Background checks and Disclosed Barring Service checks may be required.

At Victim Support, we're proud to celebrate diversity and create a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We're committed to being an antiracist organisation, and we actively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including those from Black and Asian and other minoritised communities.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet all essential criteria for a job where it is practicable to do so. We are also happy to make reasonable adjustments during the recruitment and selection process.

How to apply

To apply for this role please follow the link below to the Jobs page on our website and complete the application form demonstrating how you meet the essential shortlisting criteria.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, if we receive enough suitable applications to take forward to interview prior to the published closing date. If you have already registered & started an application, then we will contact you to advise of the amended closing date wherever possible.
